blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —For Alvin Delos Santos. Philippine weightlifting young star Albert Ian Delos Santos dedicated his breakthrough Asian Games bronze medal to his late father, Alvin, a former national weightlifter. The 20-year-old Delos Santos carried his father’s picture with him after shattering his junior world record twice in his final two clean and jerk attempts–181 and 183 kilograms–for a total of 324 kg to seal the bronze medal in the men’s 70-kg final Saturday at Nagoya City Trade and Industry Center.
